tasks.title: Three of the four community stats still read XX
tasks.note: STRATEGY DELIVERED 2026-08-13: notes/explorer/content-gaps.md §2. Key finding — the grid's own border rules (border-right except :nth-child(2n), border-bottom except :nth-last-child(-n+2)) mean 3 cells BREAKS STRUCTURALLY (cell 3 sits alone in the left column with a rule pointing at empty space); 2 and 4 are both clean. So sean needs ONE more number or THREE, never two. Recommended: keep the org count and event count as `N+` floors, and REPLACE 'meals/dollars donated' rather than fill it (a soft philanthropy dollar figure is the number that gets quoted back at you) with TEAM HEADCOUNT across SD & OC — HR has it today, zero research, so `12` + headcount is a clean shippable 2-cell section NOW. Recommendation to conti/sean: drop this from `launch`'s blockers — it degrades to 2 cells instead of blocking.
